detail: TestWatchTasksStreamsSnapshotChangesAndTicks fails intermittently (also on main), and scripts/cover.sh silently drops a package whose tests fail, so 'make cover' can skip internal/daemon. TestRunMeasuresFailedRuns is timing-flaky. Update 2026-11-09 (SP-014 session): seen again: 'make cover' reported 'All files >= 80%' while omitting every internal/daemon file because the RC-39 flake failed the package; SP-014 measured daemon coverage with a direct go test -coverprofile run instead. Update 2026-11-09 (SP-017 session): seen again; 'make cover' printed 'All files >= 80%' without internal/daemon; SP-017 measured the daemon files with go test -coverprofile directly.
